macros.name: ifshellescape
macros.doc: \ifshellescape is provided as a conditional to test whether shell escape is active or not.

macros.name: platformname
macros.doc: the \platformname command is defined to expand to a macro that represents the operating system.

macros.name: unknownplatform
macros.doc: If greater granularity is required to differentiate between various unix-like operating systems, then \unknownplatform can be interrogated for the platform based on the output of uname.
